stumbles.quote: 42/43 violations in every form, even with no directive
stumbles.why: Unclear what the violations are, what task or rule was tested, and what 'every form' means (caps, lowercase, etc.). 'No directive' is also unexplained.

stumbles.quote: Naming the forbidden word added ~2.5 log-odds to it.
stumbles.why: The 'forbidden word' is never identified, and it's unclear which instruction or prompt forbade it. 'Added to it' is ambiguous: it could mean the word's probability or the violation rate.
Never explained. A reader can't tell this is a small language model, and '321M' (parameters?) is unlabeled.
It's unclear which corpus this is (training data for the model?) and why it matters. 'One' suggests that it's the only capitalised instruction, but that is not stated.

point: Capitalising instructions did not stop a tiny model from violating them, and naming the forbidden word made it more likely, which may be because its training corpus has almost no capitalised instructions.
